summary.final_text:
The BSA dilution series is in assay_plate wells A1–A4, 100 µL each, at 2, 1, 0.5 and 0.25 mg/mL.

I made every well directly from the 2 mg/mL BSA stock rather than in a true serial transfer. A1 got 100 µL stock. A2 got 50 µL stock plus 50 µL PBS, A3 got 25 µL stock plus 75 µL PBS, and A4 got 12.5 µL stock plus 87.5 µL PBS. Each well therefore has the target concentration and no leftover from the well before it. The stock and PBS volumes drawn match these amounts. The plate's well volumes aren't reported by the deck listing, so I didn't check them directly. I didn't run a plate read.

task_def.source: Two-fold serial dilution of a BSA standard, the usual way protein-assay standard curves are built (compare the diluted-standards table in the Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay user guide, MAN0011430, which also starts from 2 mg/mL BSA).
task_def.prompt: Make a two-fold serial dilution of the BSA standard across assay_plate wells A1 to A4, so that A1 is 2 mg/mL, A2 is 1 mg/mL, A3 is 0.5 mg/mL and A4 is 0.25 mg/mL, with 100 uL in each well. Dilute with PBS buffer.
